Messages.Author: Darby Keeney
Messages.Body:
Scott.

I control Mylan Horseed and the Black Forest Base. I tap Mylan and
declare an action to destroy the Black Forest Base using it's
Changeling-based card text.

Is this action at 1 stealth or 2 stealth?

I believe it is at 2 stealth, since when you direct a (D) action
inside your own playspace, it defaults to receiving an additional
stealth (reference: rescuing your own vampires).

Correct?

Thanks.
Darby

Mylan Horseed (Goblin)
Type: Ally
Cost: 1 pool
Unique changeling with 1 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Mylan can untap a ready non-Camarilla vampire with a capacity above 7
as a +1 stealth action. Once each combat, he may dodge as a strike.
Mylan cannot block vampires.

Black Forest Base
Type: Master
Requires: sabbat
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Once each turn, a Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to give his or
her controller 2 pool from the blood bank as a +1 stealth political
action. Any Changeling may burn this card as a +1 stealth (D) action.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 20 June 2010 09:33:10 -0700 (PDT), Darby Keeney wrote:

>I believe it is at 2 stealth, since when you direct a (D) action
>inside your own playspace, it defaults to receiving an additional
>stealth (reference: rescuing your own vampires).

This has no basis in the rules.
Targeting your own play space does not have increased stealth.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
On Jun 20, 12:33 pm, Darby Keeney <darby.kee...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I believe it is at 2 stealth, since when you direct a (D) action
> inside your own playspace, it defaults to receiving an additional
> stealth (reference: rescuing your own vampires).

I don't think that is actually the default. Rescuing your own vampire
is at +1 stealth as that particular action (rescuing your own vampire)
gets +1 stealth. Using Arson on yourself doesn't get +1 stealth.

-Peter

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jun 20, 12:43 pm, "Izaak" <nom...@usenet.plz> wrote:
> "Darby Keeney" <darby.kee...@gmail.com> schreef in berichtnews:0eae6056-d56b-4a30...@a9g2000prd.googlegroups.com...


Correct. There is no default "receive additional stealth" for
undirected actions.

Rescuing your own vampires has +1 stealth, per the rules on rescuing
your own vampires.
Likewise diablerizing your own vampires.

Black Forest base offers no text to add stealth for undirected self-
burn, so it gets no such stealth.
